root.label: Ro Khanna requests AI firms information on China model-weight access

events.label: Ro Khanna requests AI firms information on China model-weight access

slots.name: request date
slots.sentence: The leading Democrat on the House’s China Select Committee is calling on the U.S.’s leading AI labs for information on Beijing’s alleged efforts to steal model weights from their firms. Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.), the ranking member of the House Select Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, requested data on Thursday from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Alphabet, the parent company of Google, expressing concerns …

slots.name: response status
slots.sentence: Neither the companies nor the Chinese Embassy in Washington immediately responded to request for comment.
